children: Presidio Property Trust commenced an exchange offer to convert Series D preferred shares into 5.5 shares of Series A common stock per preferred share.
Launched Exchange Offer to exchange all outstanding 9.375% Series D preferred for newly issued Series A common stock.
Exchange ratio: each validly tendered Series D share receives 5.5 shares of common stock if accepted by Oct 2, 2026.
No fractional common shares issued—allocations rounded up at participant level to nearest whole share.
Offer not contingent on minimum tendered shares; subject to other conditions and SEC-filed registration and Schedule TO.
As of Sept 2, 2026, 973,736 shares of Series D preferred were outstanding; Broadridge serving as information and exchange agent.
